sources.evidence: Bosch's current official media material states that large-scale production of the fuel-cell power module started at the Stuttgart-Feuerbach plant in mid-2023 and describes continued production and testing activity.

Mercedes-Benz Group's current Sindelfingen location profile identifies Factory 56 as an operating assembly hall at the Sindelfingen plant and states that the site manufactures the S-Class, S-Class Maybach and all-electric EQS.

name: Dongfeng Honda New Energy Vehicle Production Plant

sources.evidence: Honda's current global manufacturing-facilities directory lists Dongfeng Honda Automobile Co., Ltd. in Wuhan and its New Energy Vehicle Production Plant with production starting in September 2024 and annual capacity of 120,000 units.
Honda's official opening release confirms that the Wuhan NEV plant started operation in 2024 and describes automated assembly and parts-logistics operations.

Toyota's current Japan production-site directory, current as of August 4, 2026, lists Teiho Plant as an operating production site for mechanical equipment and moldings for resin, casting and forging, with production starting in February 1986.
